plain: Nudging a model's behaviour while it runs by changing its internal numbers along a chosen direction.
eli5: Turning one dial inside the robot's head to make it a bit happier or sadder.
technical: Intervening on activations during generation to change behaviour; the maps use two forms: adding a direction times a coefficient to the residual stream at one layer (the Pain Axis paper), and clamping a sparse-autoencoder feature up or down ("feature steering", Anthropic's Scaling Monosemanticity 2024).
